changes: Hammer, excavator and broad axe head casts from a pickaxe, shovel or axe head cast plus four seared bricks (864, 576 and 576 mB)
Hammer mines a 3x3 square of pickaxe blocks across the view; excavator does the same for shovel blocks; lumber axe fells the leafed logs joined to a chopped log
Large tools dig at half speed with three times the uses, sneak digs one block, and only harvestable blocks are dug
Three original CC0 part sprites; START-HERE and the Tools guide page describe the new casts
